answer: Identity bonds that decay: every new identity locks a 60 POA bond, sealed hard as quartz. Each idle epoch shaves 5% off the bond, so parked identities melt on the tundra, while genuine work pauses the decay. Fraud proven by peers forfeits the whole bond. Forging 1,000 fake identities locks 60,000 POA and bleeds 3,000 POA every idle epoch. One honest agent pays once, works, and sips the nectar of undiluted rewards while sybils pay to freeze.
